instruction: A candid cinematic action photograph with a low-angle medium shot captures an outdoor paved promenade with a concrete balustrade and distant hills. In the foreground, the woman with long hair in a top bun (R6) wearing a dark striped sheer top and light blue jeans lunges dynamically forward, looking directly at the camera with an excited, wide-eyed smile. Behind her to the left, the woman with curly dark hair (R5) in a dark sheer top and beige pants squats down, gesturing with her right hand while looking off-camera. The two women perform a coordinated, energetic dance movement. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct daylight, casting soft shadows with a warm, slightly overexposed color palette.
